## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` is green
- [ ] A new or changed provider module has its fake and a recording that passes `src/fixtures-privacy.test.ts`
- [ ] A change users can see has its line in `CHANGELOG.md` under `Unreleased`
- [ ] No copied code, or copied code from an Apache 2.0 or MIT source credited in `NOTICE` and a header comment
